verdict.rationale: Solid components are plain JavaScript functions that run once to set up their view. They declare reactive state that only reruns dependent code, and JSX, fragments, Context and Stores support composition and shared state (solid-gh-9, solid-gh-14, solid-gh-1, solid-gh-10, solid-gh-2, solid-gh-11). Hands-on reports confirm it works at scale: one user ported react-bootstrap painlessly and another ran a largish product on Solid for over a year (solid-comm-4, solid-comm-10). Some users find the props object awkward to keep reactive (solid-comm-7, solid-comm-16). Missing for 10: explicit first-party documentation of component-local state primitives and props/children composition patterns, and a clean props reactivity model without the special-props-object caveat.
